BEFORE YOU START

Install Node.js 22 or newer and a supported coding CLI: Codex, Claude Code, or Antigravity. Sign in and configure Figma access in your provider. Provider subscriptions and usage limits still apply.

Opening on macOS

If macOS shows an initial verification prompt on first launch, you can open Phibee using any of these simple steps:

Right-Click & Open

In Applications, right-click (or Control-click) Phibee.app → select Open → click Open in the confirmation dialog.

System Settings

Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to the Security section, and click “Open Anyway”.

Terminal

Run this command once in your terminal to clear the quarantine flag:

xattr -cr /Applications/Phibee.app
What should I know about this preview? +

Phibee is an early desktop release. Downloads are not yet signed or notarized, so your operating system may display a security warning. Native terminal checks are separate from full provider and Figma testing on each operating system. Your project files stay on your computer; your selected AI provider and Figma still use their online services.

Do I need another AI subscription? +

Phibee uses the coding tools you already have. It does not include model credits. Each provider handles its own login, billing, model availability, and Figma connection.
